test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The United Nations 2024 Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) highlights that India has the highest number of people in multidimensional poverty globally, with _______ million affected.
solution:
The correct answer is __**234**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is a measure of poverty that goes beyond income, considering various aspects of deprivation.
 
• The 2024 MPI report by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHDI) provides a global overview of multidimensional poverty.
 
• India has the highest number of people living in multidimensional poverty worldwide, according to the report.
 
• The report indicates that approximately 230 million people in India are affected by multidimensional poverty.
 
• Multidimensional poverty includes deprivations in health, education, and living standards.
 
• The MPI assesses factors such as nutrition, child mortality, years of schooling, school attendance, cooking fuel, sanitation, drinking water, electricity, housing, and assets. 
 
• The report highlights that while India has made progress in reducing poverty, significant challenges remain.
 
• The 230 million figure underscores the scale of poverty in India, despite its economic growth.
 
• The MPI provides a more comprehensive understanding of poverty than traditional income-based measures.
 
• The data from the MPI can be used to inform policy decisions and target interventions to reduce poverty.
 
• The report emphasizes the importance of addressing multiple dimensions of poverty simultaneously.
 
• The report also shows that children are disproportionately affected by multidimensional poverty.
 
• The MPI report provides insights into the regional disparities in poverty within India.
 
• The report also highlights the importance of data collection and analysis in monitoring poverty trends.
 
• The index is designed to give policy makers and global organizations the best data to help alleviate poverty.
 
• The MPI is a valuable tool for tracking progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 1 (No Poverty).
 
• The report emphasizes the need for targeted interventions to address the specific deprivations faced by different populations.
 
• The 2024 MPI report provides a comprehensive picture of global multidimensional poverty, with a strong focus on India.
 
• The report serves as a call to action for governments, organizations, and individuals to work together to reduce poverty in all its forms.
 
• The MPI is an important tool for understanding the complexity of poverty.
